```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper_Seurat.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))

clust_pal_list <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(results_dir, "cluster_annotations.xlsx")) %>% 
    tidyr::fill(Subset, clustering) %>% 
    named_group_split(Subset, clustering) %>% 
    set_names(c("M", "Twdoublets", "T", "full", "Mwdoublets")) %>% 
    imap(~set_names(..1$color, paste0(..1$cluster, ": ", ..1$cluster_ID)))
```

# Read in Seurat objects

```{r}
so_T <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets.rds"))
```

# Trdc expression

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_T, genes = "Trdc") %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "Trdc", pointsize = 2.4, pixels = c(1024, 1024))
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_T, genes = "Trdc") %>%
    group_by(mouse, genotype, treatment, clusters_T) %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(Trdc) +
    geom_histogram() +
    facet_wrap( ~ clusters_T) +
    scale_y_log10()
```

```{r}
trdc_T_cells <- get_metadata_from_so(so_T, genes = "Trdc") %>% 
    filter(!str_detect(clusters_T, "NK")) %>% 
    filter(Trdc > 0) %>% 
    .$cell
print(length(trdc_T_cells))
print(nrow(get_metadata_from_so(so_T)))
print(length(trdc_T_cells) / nrow(get_metadata_from_so(so_T)))
```

# Subset gdT cells

```{r}
so_gdT <- subset(so_T, cells = trdc_T_cells)
```

```{r}
so_gdT <- run_seurat_rna_workflow(so_gdT)
```

```{r}
for (res in seq(0.2, 0.8, 0.1)) {
    so_gdT <- FindClusters(so_gdT, resolution = res)
}
```

# Clustering

```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 7}
clustree::clustree(so_gdT, prefix = "RNA_snn_res.")
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 7}
get_metadata_from_so(so_gdT) %>% 
    dplyr::select(cell, UMAP_1, UMAP_2, all_of(str_subset(colnames(.), "RNA_snn_res."))) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(str_subset(colnames(.), "RNA_snn_res.")), 
                 names_to = "clustering", 
                 values_to = "cluster") %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "cluster", pointsize = 3.1, 
              label = TRUE, label_groups = "clustering") + 
    facet_wrap(~clustering, ncol = 3)
```

# Identify differential markers 

```{r}
markers05_df <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(
        results_dir, 
        "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_subsetgdT_markers05.rds"
    ), 
    function() {FindAllMarkers(so_gdT %>% set_idents("RNA_snn_res.0.5"))}
)
write_csv(markers05_df, file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_markers05.csv"))
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_gdT) %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "group", pointsize = 5.1) + 
    facet_wrap(~group)
```


# Plot markers

```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 7}
genes <- c("Cd3e", "Trdc", "Cd4", "Cd8a", "Trac", "Klrk1", "Mki67", "Prf1", "Gzmb")
get_metadata_from_so(so_gdT, genes = genes) %>% 
    dplyr::select(cell, UMAP_1, UMAP_2, genes) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = genes, 
                 names_to = "genes", 
                 values_to = "expr") %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "expr", pointsize = 10.9, pixels = c(1024, 1024)) + 
    facet_wrap(~genes, ncol = 3)
```

```{r}
genes <- c("Cd3e", "Trdc", "Cd4", "Cd8a", "Trac", "Klrk1", "Prf1", "Gzmb")
get_metadata_from_so(so_gdT, genes = genes) %>% 
    filter(RNA_snn_res.0.5 %in% c("0", "3")) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = genes, 
                 names_to = "genes", 
                 values_to = "expr") %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(group, expr)  + 
    geom_violin(aes(fill = group), color = NA) +
    geom_jitter(size = 0.5, width = 0.2) + 
    facet_wrap(~genes, ncol = 4) + 
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("Ctrl__CD40 agonist", "Ctrl__Isotype"), 
                                          c("B2m KO__CD40 agonist", 
                                            "B2m KO__Isotype"))) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = ~c(..1[[1]], ..1[[2]]*1.3)) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + 
    labs(caption = "Only res 0.5 clusters 0 and 3")
```
